integrity.title: Audit log integrity
integrity.description: Check that no audit event was changed, removed or inserted afterwards.
integrity.noAccessTitle: You can't check the audit log
integrity.noAccessBody: This check is for staff who can read the audit log, such as the principal. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.
integrity.howBody: Every audit event is linked to the one before it by a fingerprint. The check recomputes every fingerprint from the first event to the last. It reads the whole log, so it can take a minute in a large school.
integrity.checkingBody: Checking the audit log. Keep this page open.
integrity.okBody: Verified up to event {last}: {count, plural, one {# event was} other {# events were}} checked and none was changed.
integrity.okEmpty: There are no audit events to check yet.

integrity.brokenIntact: Events before it are intact ({count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}, up to event {last}).
integrity.brokenFromStart: The problem starts at the first event.
integrity.brokenAction: Do not try to fix this yourself. Contact SchoolOS support now and tell them the event number above.

reason.duplicate_seq: Two events have the same number.
reason.seq_gap: An event is missing: the numbers skip one.
reason.prev_hash_mismatch: This event is not linked to the event before it.

reason.head_missing: The record of the latest event is missing.
reason.head_mismatch: The latest event does not match the recorded end of the log.
reason.other: The events do not link up as expected.

integrity.notRunBody: Run the check to see whether every event is still linked to the one before it.

fields.schoolNameHint: The name staff and parents know the school by.

fields.sharedHint: Runs on the shared SchoolOS platform in Mumbai. Suits most schools.

provision.doneDedicated: The deployment, subscription and billing account are recorded. Build the host with the runbook next.

ownerInvite.existing: The owner already has a SchoolOS account; they were added to this school.

plans.title: Plans and pricing
plans.description: Plans are versioned: a published plan never changes. Prices are in rupees; GST is added on invoices.
plans.draftNote: This saves a draft. Publish it to offer it to schools.
plans.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example standard.
plans.codeNewVersionHint: Same code: this becomes the next version.
plans.sacHint: Six digits; leave empty for the default.
plans.limitsHint: Leave empty for no limit. Limits never block school work; they trigger alerts at 80% and 100%.

plans.retireBody: No new subscriptions can use it. Existing subscriptions continue.
plans.emptyBody: Create and publish a plan with prices and limits before provisioning schools.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Trials, active and past-due subscriptions. Plan changes take effect from the next period.
subscriptions.cancelsAtPeriodEnd: Cancels at the end of this period
subscriptions.emptyBody: A subscription is created when you provision a school.

subscriptions.noPublishedPlans: No other published plan for this tier.

invoices.title: Invoices

invoices.referenceHint: UTR, UPI reference or cheque number.

usage.title: Usage and quotas
usage.description: Daily totals for each school. Alerts go out at 80% and 100% of plan limits. Counts only, never personal data.

usage.limitsDescription: Counts for {date}, compared with the limits of the school's current plan.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for everyone, for a percentage of schools, or for specific schools. A school's own setting wins.

flags.keyHint: Lowercase dotted name, for example ask.citations_v2. It cannot change later.

flags.switchHint: Switching a flag asks you to confirm first. Nothing changes until you do.
flags.turnOnBody: Schools without their own override get this feature, within the rollout percentage. It applies within a minute.
flags.turnOffBody: Schools without their own override lose this feature. Schools forced on keep it. It applies within a minute.

fleet.versionsEmptyBody: Versions appear after deployments send their first heartbeat.

structure_archived.body: The academic year or class is archived. Turn on "Show archived", unarchive it, then try again.

no_promotion.title: There is nothing to undo
no_promotion.body: This year has no promotion that can be undone. Reload the page to see its current state.

promotion_held_back_not_in_year.title: A chosen student is not in this year
promotion_held_back_not_in_year.body: One of the students you chose is not enrolled in this academic year. Remove them from "Students who stay in the same class" and preview again.

promotion_target_not_later.title: Choose a later year
promotion_target_not_later.body: Students can only be promoted into an academic year that starts after this one. Choose another year.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Circulars, policies, meeting minutes and other school documents. Every file is checked for viruses before anyone can open it.
documents.noAccessBody: Documents are for staff with document access. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.

C1.hint: For school staff only, with no personal details (for example a holiday circular).

C3.hint: Sensitive details such as health, category, income or identity papers. Only staff allowed to see sensitive data, and the person who uploaded it, can open the file.

reason.busy: SchoolOS is checking this file. It can be opened once the check has passed, usually within a few minutes. This page updates by itself.
reason.malware_detected: The virus check found a threat in this file, so it was blocked and cannot be opened. Check the file on your computer with your antivirus, then upload a clean copy as a new version.
reason.aadhaar_detected: This file showed a full Aadhaar number, so SchoolOS keeps it from being opened. SchoolOS never shows or stores full Aadhaar numbers. Upload a copy with the number covered, showing only the last 4 digits.
reason.aadhaar_redacted: This file showed a full Aadhaar number. SchoolOS saved a copy with the number hidden as the next version and removed this one. Use the newer version.
reason.aadhaar_unredactable: This file showed a full Aadhaar number that SchoolOS could not hide, so the file was removed. Upload a copy with the number covered, showing only the last 4 digits.
reason.scan_unavailable: The virus check could not be done, so the file cannot be opened. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.
reason.storage_unavailable: The file could not be read for the virus check. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.
reason.quarantined_other: This file was blocked and cannot be opened. Upload a new version, or contact SchoolOS support if you are not sure why.
reason.failed_other: This file could not be checked, so it cannot be opened. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.

list.updating: Some files are still being checked. This list updates by itself.

detail.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support.
detail.stillChecking: A file is still being checked. This page updates by itself.

detail.deleteHint: Deleting removes every version and its files. It cannot be undone.

detail.archivedBody: It is kept with all its versions and can still be opened, but it is listed only under "Archived". To change its details or add a version, unarchive it first.

acl.limitedTo: Only these staff (if they also have document access):

aclEdit.description: The change applies right away and is recorded in the audit log.

document_in_use.title: This document must be kept

document_not_ready.body: It has not passed the virus check. Wait a few minutes and try again; this page updates by itself.

sensitive_document.title: This file is restricted
sensitive_document.body: Only staff allowed to see sensitive data, and the person who uploaded it, can open it. Ask your school's office admin if you need it.

file_too_large.title: The file is too large
file_too_large.body: Files can be at most 25 MB. Scan at a lower resolution or split the document, then try again.

upload_expired.title: The upload took too long
upload_expired.body: Choose the file again and press upload. On a slow connection, try a smaller file.

upload_already_used.title: This upload was already saved
upload_already_used.body: Go back to the documents list to find it. To add the file again, choose it and upload once more.

document_archived.body: Its details can't be changed while it is archived. Reload the page, unarchive it, then try again.

edit.issuedOnHint: The date printed on the document. Leave it empty to remove it.

features.title: What SchoolOS does for your office
features.intro: Built around the work the office already does, so staff type less and correct less.

import.title: Enter once, import the rest
import.body: Bring in the Excel or Google Sheets lists you already keep, or photograph register pages and confirm each row. You can undo an import within 24 hours.

checks.title: Catch mismatches early
checks.body: Each student's details are compared with the admission register, Aadhaar as printed, UDISE+ and board registration. Differences become findings before you submit to a portal.

changes.title: Corrections with a second check
changes.body: SchoolOS never corrects official records on its own. Changes to a name, date of birth or parents' names need an evidence document and approval by another person.

certificates.title: Certificates and registers
certificates.body: Printable certificates and registers in English and Telugu, in your school's familiar formats. This is the next module we are building.

ask.title: Ask the school
ask.body: Ask in English or Telugu. Answers come from your school's own records and documents and show their sources, or say that nothing was found in the school records.

audit.title: A record of every change
audit.body: Changes to student details, role changes, exports, sign-ins and questions asked are written to an audit log that cannot be edited, and you can check it for tampering.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Three steps, using the records you already have.

import.title: Import
import.body: Upload the lists you already keep, or photograph admission register pages. Staff confirm what was read before anything becomes a student record.

check.title: Check
check.body: SchoolOS compares each student's details across sources and lists every mismatch and missing field, with the record that likely needs correcting.

submit.title: Submit with confidence
submit.body: Fix mismatches through approved changes, then download pre-check sheets for UDISE+ and board registration. Your staff still submit on the portal, as today.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.intro: Student records are children's data. SchoolOS is built to keep them safe and private from the start.

india.title: Data stays in India
india.body: Your school's data is stored in AWS Mumbai, with encrypted backups in Hyderabad.

isolation.title: Each school is kept apart
isolation.body: Every school's records are separated in the database itself, so one school can never see another school's data.

aadhaar.title: No Aadhaar numbers
aadhaar.body: SchoolOS never stores Aadhaar numbers: only the last 4 digits and the details as printed on the card.

audit.title: Every change and question is recorded
audit.body: Changes to student details and every question asked of the AI are written to the school's audit log.

ai.title: AI sees only what you can see
ai.body: Answers use only the records and documents the person asking is allowed to see. Everything else is filtered out before the AI reads anything.

support.title: No standing access for our staff
support.body: SchoolOS staff cannot open your school's records unless your owner or principal approves it, for a limited time, and every screen they open is recorded.

plans.title: Two ways to run SchoolOS
plans.intro: Both have the same features, the same security and keep data in India. Pricing is agreed with each school before it starts.

shared.name: Shared
shared.summary: Your school is a separate, isolated school on the SchoolOS platform in AWS Mumbai. The simplest choice for most schools.
shared.point1: Managed, updated and backed up by SchoolOS
shared.point2: No IT work for your school
shared.point3: Works in a browser on your office PCs

dedicated.name: Dedicated
dedicated.summary: Your own isolated server in AWS Mumbai running the same software, with its own storage and encryption key.
dedicated.point2: Optional web address on your school's own domain
dedicated.point3: For larger schools, school groups or schools that want their own server

portal.q: Does SchoolOS submit to UDISE+ or board portals for us?
portal.a: No. The portals do not offer a way to do that. SchoolOS checks your data and prepares sheets in the portal's field order; your staff submit as they do today.

register.q: Will SchoolOS change our admission register?
register.a: No. The admission register stays the legal record. SchoolOS points out differences, and any correction goes through a change request with evidence, approved by a second person.

tools.q: Do we have to stop using Excel, Tally or paper registers?
tools.a: No. SchoolOS works alongside them. It imports and reads what you already keep.

ai.q: Where do the answers in Ask the school come from?
ai.a: Only from your school's own records and documents that the person asking may see. Every answer shows its sources, or says it was not found in the school records.

training.q: Is our student data used to train AI?
training.a: No. Your school's data is never used to train AI models.

exit.q: Can we take our data with us?
exit.a: Yes. Your school owns its data and can export everything in open formats at any time. If you leave, your data is deleted and its encryption keys are destroyed.

dataExport.title: Data export
dataExport.description: Download all of your school's records, documents and audit log in one file. Only the owner can do this.
dataExport.ownerOnlyTitle: Only the owner can export all data
dataExport.ownerOnlyBody: Exporting everything the school holds is kept for the school's owner. Ask the owner if you need a copy of the school's data.
dataExport.requestDescription: SchoolOS prepares one ZIP file in the background. You will get a notification when it is ready.

includes.records: Every record table as a CSV file (opens in Excel) and a JSON file: students with the values from every source, guardians, enrolments, corrections, data checks, imports, staff and school structure.
includes.documents: Every uploaded document that passed the virus check.
includes.audit: The school's audit log as a CSV file, and a list of what is in the file.
includes.never: Full Aadhaar numbers are never stored, so they are never in the file. The name, date of birth and gender as printed on Aadhaar are never exported.

dataExport.sensitiveHint: Health notes, category, caste, religion, guardian phone numbers and addresses and the last four Aadhaar digits. Without this they show as ••••. The audit log records that they were included.
dataExport.sensitiveNotAllowed: Restricted details (health notes, category, guardian phone numbers) will show as ••••. Only staff allowed to see them for the whole school can include them.
dataExport.careTitle: This file holds children's personal data
dataExport.careBody: Keep it on a secure computer, do not email it, and delete copies you no longer need. The file is deleted from SchoolOS 24 hours after it is ready.
dataExport.busyNote: An export is being made. Wait for it to finish.
dataExport.requested: Your export has been requested. This page updates while it is being made.
dataExport.busyBody: Large schools can take several minutes. You can leave this page; you will be notified when it is ready.
dataExport.readyBody: You can download the file until {expires}. After that it is deleted and you can make a new one.
dataExport.failedTitle: The export could not be made
dataExport.expiredBody: Full exports are deleted 24 hours after they are ready. Make a new export to get up-to-date data.
dataExport.linkNote: The download link works for 5 minutes. Press the button again for a new link.
dataExport.historyDescription: Every full export of the school: who asked for it and when. The record stays after the file is deleted.

failure.permission_revoked: The person who asked for it is no longer allowed to export all data. The owner can make a new export.
failure.too_large: The school's documents are too large for one file. Contact SchoolOS support: they can prepare the export in parts.
failure.too_many_audit_events: The audit log is too long for one file. Contact SchoolOS support.
failure.integrity_mismatch: A stored document did not match its check, so the file was not made. Contact SchoolOS support.
failure.worker_error: Something went wrong on our side. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.
failure.other: Something went wrong. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: How long SchoolOS keeps working data before deleting it. You can shorten these periods; SchoolOS never keeps data longer than the limits shown.
retention.notAllowedTitle: Only the owner and principal can see this
retention.notAllowedBody: Retention settings are part of the school settings. Ask your owner or principal.
retention.editableDescription: A daily job deletes this data when the period is over.
retention.fixedDescription: These periods are set by law, for security, or by how the feature works, and cannot be changed here.
retention.recordsNote: Student records, admission registers and documents you upload are never deleted automatically. They are kept as your school's records.
retention.saveBody: Shorter periods apply from the next daily clean-up. The change is recorded in the audit log.

outcome.unchanged: Nothing changed, so nothing was saved.

import_raw_files.about: Spreadsheets uploaded to add students. The values added to student records stay.

exports.name: Export files
exports.about: Pre-check reports and student lists made on the Exports screen. The record of who exported what stays.

notifications_read.name: Read notifications
notifications_read.about: Notifications you have already opened. Unread ones are kept.

tenant_exports.about: The file made on the Data export screen. It can be downloaded for 24 hours.

kb_queries.name: Ask the school questions and answers
kb_queries.about: Questions asked in Ask the school and their answers, kept encrypted.

audit_events.name: Audit log
audit_events.about: Who did what and when. Kept at least 13 months as the law requires, then archived.

tenant_export_in_progress.title: An export is already being made
tenant_export_in_progress.body: Wait until it is ready, then download it or make a new one.

sensitive_not_allowed.title: You can't include restricted details
sensitive_not_allowed.body: Only staff allowed to see restricted details for the whole school can include them. Make the export without them.

export_not_ready.title: The export is not ready yet
export_not_ready.body: Wait a moment and try again. This page updates on its own.

export_failed.title: The export could not be made
export_failed.body: Make a new export. If it fails again, contact SchoolOS support.

export_expired.title: This file has been deleted
export_expired.body: Full exports are deleted 24 hours after they are ready. Make a new export.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed these settings first
precondition_failed.body: Select “Load the latest settings” to see their change, then make yours again.
